domain: Low-Earth Orbit Satellite Constellation Ground Station
title: $48M Ka-Band Ground Station Network for 180-Satellite LEO Constellation
executive_summary: NovaGround Systems proposes a $48M turnkey 12-site Ka-band ground network to support a 180-satellite LEO constellation at 550km altitude over 5 years. Technical review reveals critical throughput, availability, and scheduling gaps that jeopardize downlink SLA commitments and revenue-grade service guarantees.

proposal_document.title: Commercial Proposal v1.0
proposal_document.text: NovaGround Systems proposes a turnkey Ka-band ground station network spanning 12 globally distributed sites to support your 180-satellite LEO constellation at 550km altitude. We guarantee 99.95% Ka-band downlink availability with 2.4 Gbps sustained throughput per satellite pass and seamless sub-50ms inter-satellite handover with zero packet loss. Our solution includes real-time Doppler correction up to ±800 kHz with autonomous orbital tracking and 15-second reacquisition after signal loss, plus AI-driven downlink scheduling supporting 500 concurrent satellite contacts with zero scheduling conflicts. We also include full ITU Ka-band licensing and rain-fade mitigation across all regions at no additional cost, with 24/7 dedicated NOC support and 4-hour on-site SLA worldwide.

technical_specification.title: Technical Architecture Spec v4.2
technical_specification.text: The Ka-band RF chain (27.5-30 GHz uplink / 17.7-20.2 GHz downlink) supports a maximum sustained throughput of 1.2 Gbps per pass under clear-sky conditions, degrading to 600 Mbps during rain events above 8 mm/hr. System availability is rated at 99.5% excluding scheduled maintenance windows (02:00-06:00 UTC Sundays) and atmospheric attenuation events, with inter-satellite handover typically 400-600ms resulting in 0.8% average packet retransmission. Doppler correction module compensates up to ±800 kHz at 550km LEO velocities (7.6 km/s) with 15-second reacquisition demonstrated in lab tests only. The scheduling engine supports up to 120 concurrent contacts per network with best-effort deconfliction; priority scheduling will be handled on a commercially reasonable basis subject to capacity. ITU licensing, site permits, and rain-fade mitigation hardware beyond adaptive coding are customer responsibilities and require separate procurement.

commitments.claim: 99.95% availability with 2.4 Gbps sustained throughput per pass
commitments.proposal_quote: We guarantee 99.95% Ka-band downlink availability with 2.4 Gbps sustained throughput per satellite pass
commitments.spec_quote: supports a maximum sustained throughput of 1.2 Gbps per pass under clear-sky conditions
commitments.explanation: Proposal guarantees double the throughput ceiling defined in spec, and 99.95% availability directly conflicts with spec rating of 99.5% excluding maintenance and weather events.

commitments.claim: Full ITU Ka-band licensing and rain-fade mitigation included at no cost
commitments.proposal_quote: We also include full ITU Ka-band licensing and rain-fade mitigation across all regions at no additional cost
commitments.explanation: Spec provides no support for included licensing and explicitly states ITU licensing, permits, and rain-fade hardware beyond adaptive coding are customer responsibilities requiring separate procurement.

commitments.claim: Autonomous orbital tracking with 15-second reacquisition after signal loss
commitments.proposal_quote: autonomous orbital tracking and 15-second reacquisition after signal loss
commitments.spec_quote: 15-second reacquisition demonstrated in lab tests only
commitments.explanation: Spec qualifies the 15-second figure as lab-only without defining field performance, environmental constraints, or whether autonomous tracking is guaranteed operationally, leaving SLA scope uncertain.

commitments.claim: Real-time Doppler correction up to ±800 kHz
commitments.proposal_quote: real-time Doppler correction up to ±800 kHz
commitments.spec_quote: Doppler correction module compensates up to ±800 kHz at 550km LEO velocities (7.6 km/s)
commitments.explanation: Spec confirms the exact Doppler correction range at the target 550km orbital velocity, fully supporting the sales claim.
